dispatcher_design: copier_mutation_dispatch_enabled (default OFF, ANDed with copier_live_execute_enabled -> the whole arm stack). dispatch_one: claim PENDING->RUNNING under select_for_update (single-flight); gate_check (default live_execution._relock_live_authz_for_lifecycle) re-checks the governing authority at send time, refusing (leave PENDING) on revoke/expiry/kill-switch; _build_command stamps the migration-free watermark; transport(command) sends at most once; record_lifecycle_outcome persists the outcome; job/replication finalised APPLIED->SUCCESS/EXECUTION_VERIFIED, terminal-failure->FAILED/EXECUTION_FAILED, UNKNOWN->RUNNING (reconcile, never success). The INERT default transport reverts the job to PENDING (nothing sent).
no_widening_no_late_recovery_proof: The dispatcher sends only EXISTING MODIFY/CLOSE jobs on a bound follower ticket; it opens no position, creates no ExecutionJob, and never recovers a late entry. It cannot reach a broker on its own: the default transport is inert and no real per-tenant transport is provisioned. The three bridge money functions keep the account_not_demo wall, so a LIVE mutation stays independently fail-closed (the RED admission is designed, not built). PARTIAL_CLOSE keeps its dedicated worker (excluded).
